summary: ```markdown # Group Internal Lines | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, it's Phoebe, and I have a great update for you with internal lines in our 2025.0 release. So let's dive on in and have some fun while we learn. ## Grouping Internal Lines Now, what you can do with internal lines is, get ready for it, group them. Using your Transform Pattern Tool up top here, you can select all of your internal lines or shapes. These are all shapes that were traced from a graphic. ### Grouping Process Now what I can do is right-click on top of it, go to "Group," and then select "Group." What will happen is when I move this, they will all move together. If I scale this, it'll all scale together. If I go to my Edit Pattern Tool, though, it will then start to adjust individually, as you can see. ### Individual Adjustments I can then select some individually as well. All of that can be managed by right-clicking and grouping just this selection, or I could ungroup. I could also select all of these, right-click, and ungroup. After that, I can reselect and right-click to group them all together again, all with my Edit Pattern Tool. ### Transform Pattern Tool Behavior Just know that the grouping will be honored when using your Transform Pattern Tool. The Transform Pattern Tool will recognize the grouping the most. ## Working with Lines Now, what I'm going to do is show you about lines. I'm going to go down here and go to my Transform Pattern Tool again. If I just go to my Edit Pattern Tool and try to select these internal lines like so, I'll right-click, and the group option will not be there, as you can see. ### Selecting Internal Lines With my Edit Pattern Tool, I will go through and select each and every internal line by holding down Shift and clicking once with my left mouse button to select each line. Then, I'm going to right-click on top of it, select "Group," and then "Group" again. Now these will be grouped together, so if I click and move, pretty cool, right? ### Additional Options I could right-click to delete, maybe I want to resize—everything is possible once grouped. I can also right-click to group or ungroup, but again, with your Edit Pattern Tool, it's only going to edit the individual lines. However, with your Transform Pattern Tool, it will follow and honor the group. ## Conclusion Thanks so much for watching! If you have any questions, use that comment section down below. Don't forget to like and subscribe, and thanks again so much for watching. Keep having fun in Cloud! I'll see you in the next video. Bye bye. ```
